title: What Is Web Development?
description: A placeholder chapter while the Web Development track is being written. Here's the short version of what you'll learn.

content.value: This Track Is Still Being Built
Full lessons for Web Development are on the way. This page is a placeholder so you can see where the track will live, what it covers, and roughly what order it'll come in.
Web development is building the things you open in a browser: websites, web apps, games, dashboards. Every one of them is made from the same three ingredients working together.

🧱  HTML  → the structure: headings, text, buttons, images
🎨  CSS   → the style: colours, spacing, layout, animation
⚙️  JS    → the behaviour: what happens when you click
Think of a house. HTML is the walls and rooms, CSS is the paint and furniture, and JavaScript is the wiring that makes the lights and doorbell actually work.
Content coming soon. In the meantime, the Python track is the best place to start, most of what you learn there carries straight over to JavaScript.
